title: Maven & Gradle (Java Build Tools)
intro: Java build tool interview questions cover Maven and Gradle in interview depth — Maven lifecycle phases, dependency scopes and conflict resolution, multi-module projects, profiles, publishing artifacts; Gradle build scripts, the dependency DSL, the wrapper, multi-module builds, incremental builds, and the Maven-vs-Gradle decision (and Bazel as the third option). Use this page for any role that touches CI builds, library publishing, or migrating between build tools.
